summary: Lead Of Programming And Design At FRC Team 2130 Future Computer Engineer | Aspiring Motorsport Technology Engineer | Building Skills in Software, Electronics and Racing

experience.desc: Lead programmer on a competitive FRC robotics team. Responsible for the full software stack on the 2026 season robot, including swerve drive, autonomous path planning, and vision-based target tracking. Worked in a six-subsystem command-based architecture with WPILib Java, integrated PhotonVision across dual cameras, and built autonomous routines using PathPlannerLib. Also managed driver-station tooling through SmartDashboard.

Lead designer on a competitive FRC robotics team. Assisted in the full mechanical design of the 2026 season robot, including CAD modeling, assembly, and part selection. Designed and built a swerve drive system with custom gearboxes, and integrated sensors and electronics into the mechanical design.
